purpose: Reviewed source registry for the local Juniper Validated Designs (JVD) structured index. Mirrors the official Juniper/jvd GitHub repository's portal catalog at a pinned commit; retains the last verified snapshot and marks it stale if the source becomes unavailable. Never substitutes an unofficial mirror.

sources.refresh_policy: pin the exact commit SHA; retain last verified snapshot and mark stale if the source is unavailable or the schema changes
